newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Fosters says Molson in Coors talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Fosters says Molson in Coors talks.

text.p: Fosters Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday that its 40 percent owned Canadian brewer, Molson Breweries, had agreed to discuss a new licensing deal with Coors Brewing Co after a court ruling terminated their previous agreement.

"Molson and Colorado brewer Coors Brewing Company have agreed to discuss the possibility of a new arrangement between them and to have ongoing discussions about the terms of such an arrangement," Foster's said.
Coors and Molson said on Sunday that an independent arbritration panel in Canada had terminated the previous agreement under which Molson brewed and marketed Coors beer brands in Canada.

The three-member panel found that Molson breached its licensing agreement with Coors by allowing Miller Brewing Co, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, to acquire a 20 percent equity interest in Molson without Coors' consent.

Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel said in a statement the ruling was very surprising as Molson had acted on the basis of legal advice given at the time Miller entered into the partnership with Molson.

"With regard to the payments owing to Coors from Molson, Mr Kunkel said it was too early to assess the financial ramifications of the findings, but the market would be kept fully informed," Foster's said.
Foster's shares closed up six cents at A$2.40 on Friday.
